answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 62 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 17 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 62 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 485 sponsors, each risking real money. The ember of the design is public, the basalt of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the pearl of honest work is what finally pays.
